# Choose folder telemetry labels from flags before the Other fallback

DBViewWrapper chooses the first matching known folder flag, including Virtual, and otherwise uses Other before adding one folderOpened count. Server roots return before this probe. The order resolves folders with more than one relevant flag. The labeled-counter registry declares the same public labels. A normal folder name is not a telemetry category. The browser test checks repeated opens and categories; no folder UI or telemetry submission was run here.

Scope: Folder view and telemetry.
